query:
-- Anna Katyal rank for Appcast - look through all sponsor rankings submissions
SELECT rs.sponsorId, rs.rankings, s.companyName
FROM rankingsSubmissions rs
JOIN sponsors s ON s.id = rs.sponsorId
WHERE s.companyName IN ('Appcast', 'Harver')
ORDER BY rs.sponsorId;
